boundedQuestion: Can an explicit, mutually exclusive track-shoe configuration contract prevent ZX85 rubber and grouser variants from being collapsed into a material-only swap or from incorrectly carrying shared rollers, sprockets and axles inside the swappable variant?

novelty.relativeToCurrentBestView: N321 binds travel inputs to crawler motion, but it does not define which track-shoe configuration is installed or separate the swappable ground-contact variant from shared undercarriage running gear.

userCanonicalCorrection: The metal axles and running gear belong to the undercarriage. The track is a separate replaceable configuration; the rubber/plastic-looking track and iron/steel track must not be merged into one object or shown as simultaneous variants.

sourceFacts.fact: The standard ZX85USB-5A specification identifies a 450 mm grouser shoe and gives a 2920 mm undercarriage length and 2200 mm undercarriage width.
The manual enumerates four distinct shoe configurations: 450 mm grouser standard, 600 mm grouser option, 450 mm pad crawler option and 450 mm rubber crawler option.
The four configurations have different weights, clearances, undercarriage lengths or widths, ground pressures and intended applications; they are not a color/material-only switch.
The 600 mm grouser, 450 mm pad crawler and 450 mm rubber crawler configurations should not be used on gravel or rocky ground.

dedupRouting.N321: APPLICABLE_MOTION_PREREQUISITE_ONLY: travel input mapping does not define installed track configuration.
dedupRouting.PHYSICAL_SYMMETRY_REUSE: NOT_DUPLICATE: left/right reuse does not prove mutually exclusive configuration identity or configuration-specific dimensions.
dedupRouting.existingTrackConfigurationSearch: No matching rubber/grouser mutually exclusive configuration regression was found in the current learning-branch search.

boundaries: The fixture gate validates configuration semantics, not the current production undercarriage geometry.
Manufacturer source names are preserved; the candidate does not replace 'rubber crawler shoe' with the informal word 'plastic'.
The candidate does not assert unobserved exact materials for every shared roller, axle or mount.
No main, R2 OS, production Mother branch or production asset is modified.
